name: Seamless Episodes
author: chasem-dev
description: After a Shine Sprite is saved, the world's next episode starts right away, with its opening cutscene: no trip back to Delfino Plaza and no episode select. Works in singleplayer and when you host multiplayer; the players who join follow you.

name: First Person
author: Allebale
description: See the game through Mario's eyes: V or D-pad Down switches it on and off, and the C-stick looks around. Its options are in the game's Mods menu (F1).

name: FLUDD Weapons
author: Allebale
description: FLUDD fires a Rifle, a Submachine gun or a Bazooka: D-pad left and right choose, R fires, and D-pad up zooms the Rifle. Each weapon's numbers, long range and Shadow Mario's difficulty are in the mod's settings. With First Person, you hold the weapons in view.
